newsitem.title: USA: Thornburg to offer 2.4 mln prfrd shrs.
newsitem.headline: Thornburg to offer 2.4 mln prfrd shrs.

text.p: Thornburg Mortgage Asset Corp said Monday it was going to make a public offering of 2.4 million shares of its Series A 9.68 percent Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock at $25.00 each.
The company said Stifel, Nicolaus & Co Inc, EVEREN Securities Inc, Principal Financial Securities Inc, Sutro & Co Inc and Thornburg Securities Corp were managing the offer.
It said it expected the underwriters to buy the shares no later than January 24.
The company said it had also granted the underwriters an option to purchase up to 360,000 additional shares of preferred stock to cover over-allotments.
The Series A 9.68 percent Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock will be convertible into Thornburg Mortgage Asset Corp common stock at a conversion price of $25.00 per share.
The quarterly base dividend will be $0.605 per share.
Thornburg Mortgage Asset Corp is a special purpose mortgage financial institution that invests in a portfolio of adjustable-rate mortgage securities.
